name: flash-wasm-builder
description: Build scripts for Flash WebAssembly parser

scripts.prebuild:
node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('rustc --version', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch (e) { console.error('
❌ Rust is not installed. Install from https://rustup.rs/
   curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh
'); process.exit(1); } try { execSync('wasm-pack --version', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch (e) { console.log('📦 Installing wasm-pack...'); execSync('cargo install wasm-pack', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } try { execSync('rustup target list --installed | grep wasm32-unknown-unknown', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch (e) { console.log('🎯 Adding wasm32 target...'); execSync('rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.check-deps:
node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); console.log('
🔍 Checking dependencies...
'); try { const rustVersion = execSync('rustc --version', { encoding: 'utf8' }); console.log('✅ Rust:', rustVersion.trim()); } catch (e) { console.log('❌ Rust: Not installed'); } try { const wasmPackVersion = execSync('wasm-pack --version', { encoding: 'utf8' }); console.log('✅ wasm-pack:', wasmPackVersion.trim()); } catch (e) { console.log('❌ wasm-pack: Not installed'); } try { execSync('rustup target list --installed | grep wasm32-unknown-unknown', { stdio: 'ignore' }); console.log('✅ wasm32 target: Installed'); } catch (e) { console.log('❌ wasm32 target: Not installed'); } try { const wasmOptVersion = execSync('wasm-opt --version', { encoding: 'utf8' }); console.log('✅ wasm-opt:', wasmOptVersion.trim()); } catch (e) { console.log('⚠️  wasm-opt: Not installed (optional, but recommended for optimization)'); } console.log('
');"
